verdict.rationale: Docs show a unified API/SDK (ToolLoopAgent with `tools` defined) that works across providers via a single schema, and OpenAI Chat Completions compatibility lets existing tool-calling code work through the gateway without rewrites. However, evidence is limited to one code snippet and general unified-API claims rather than deep documentation of tool-call schema normalization across many providers, and there is no independent/hands-on confirmation of cross-provider tool-calling consistency. missing for 10: multi-provider tool-call schema mapping details, independent verification that tool calls behave identically across providers.
